verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a webhooks tool that automatically notifies you of events and changes in an applicant's verification process, so your system can react without polling. Supporting docs cover a rollout-percentage setting for webhook endpoints and webhook testing in Sandbox. However, nothing in the pack shows that payloads are signed or which lifecycle events (created, processing, verified, requires-input) are emitted. Missing for 10: evidence of webhook signing/signature verification, an enumerated list of lifecycle event types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
